page_title: BAY 5-1 HOF | Bayern Munich v Hoffenheim 08/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Hoffenheim comes to nothing.

90+2' That was a nice football moment. Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the left post. Oliver Baumann guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
90+1' The corner is swung in but Bayern Munich can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+1' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

89' 5 - 1 Goal! Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom right corner. Oliver Baumann had no chance of reaching it. The score is 5:1.

83' The opposition back off Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich), who needs no second invitation to shoot from inside the box. It's a decent effort low towards the middle of the goal, but Oliver Baumann denies him with the save.
82' Bayern Munich have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim) comes onto the pitch so that Alexander Prass can be given a rest.
81' Christian Ilzer prepares a substitution. Leon Avdullahu is replaced by Luka Djuric (Hoffenheim).
80' A substitution has been made. Alphonso Davies goes off and Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) comes on.

78' Luis Diaz plays a beautiful lofted pass to Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich), who somehow crashes the ball miles over the bar from a promising position. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
77' Bayern Munich failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
75' The resulting set piece from Hoffenheim is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
72' Lennart Karl receives a sweet cross inside the box from Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Valentin Gendrey (Hoffenheim) replaces Bazoumana Toure.
71' Christian Ilzer has decided to substitute Andrej Kramaric and he is replaced by Muhammed Damar (Hoffenheim).
69' This shall not pass! Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
68' Harry Kane will be replaced by Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich).
66' Substitution. Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Fisnik Asllani walks off.
63' The referee allows time for a substitution. Jonathan Tah will be replaced by Hiroki Ito (Bayern Munich).
63' Vincent Kompany has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) replacing Serge Gnabry.
63' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Michael Olise walks off the pitch to be replaced by Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich).
62' 4 - 1 Goal! Michael Olise plays a simple square pass into the feet of Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball low into the middle of the goal. 4:1.
61' Bayern Munich can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
61' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
59' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
58' A corner kick by Hoffenheim is thwarted by the well prepared Manuel Neuer (Bayern Munich).
57' Jonathan Tah (Bayern Munich) has tested the patience of referee Tobias Stieler and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

57' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the roof of the net, but Manuel Neuer pulls off a brilliant save. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim have been awarded a corner kick.
56' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
51' The corner from Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is intercepted by the defence.

51' The ball is crossed into the box and Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the roof of the net, but Oliver Baumann gets a glove on it to thwart him. The ball goes out of play. Bayern Munich are awarded a corner kick.
48' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Oliver Baumann intercepts the ball.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+2' 3 - 1 Goal! Harry Kane plays in Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box slots it into the bottom right corner 3:1.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' 2 - 1 Goal! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) directs his penalty into the top left corner and past Oliver Baumann.
45' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is going to take the penalty!
44' Leon Avdullahu (Hoffenheim) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision. Bayern Munich are awarded a penalty kick!

42' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) makes a rough challenge and Tobias Stieler blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Hoffenheim, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
40' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bayern Munich.

38' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) makes contact with a cross and strikes a shot towards the bottom right corner that lacks the power to find the back of the net, but the goalkeeper still has to pull off a marvellous diving save to keep his effort out.
35' 1 - 1 Goal! A great through ball by Fisnik Asllani sets up Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball low into the middle of the goal. 1:1.

35' Great save! Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Manuel Neuer. Hoffenheim force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
28' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) blows a clear opportunity! He needed only to tap the ball in, but narrowly misses the goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.

27' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) cuts inside his marker and unleashes a rocket of a shot from inside the box. The ball flies towards the right side of the goal, but it's kept out by magnificent save from Oliver Baumann.

25' How did he miss! The cross loops over the keeper leaving Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) with an empty net, but somehow he heads the ball well wide of the right post from close range. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.
22' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) misses a big opportunity after striking the ball towards goal and it goes just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
20' 1 - 0 Goal! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) puts the ball into the left side of the goal past the outstretched arm of Oliver Baumann.
19' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
17' Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) takes out his opponent with a nasty slide tackle and receives a straight red card from the referee!
17' Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) is penalised for holding. Tobias Stieler signals a set piece. The referee makes the call - penalty to Bayern Munich!
13' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is arguing with the referee and is given a caution.
12' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.

10' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) covers his face with his hands after spurning a great chance. The ball rebounded to him and his close-range header went a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
10' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.

9' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) accelerated away from the defence and took his shot early from the edge of the box. The ball flew towards the top left corner, but Oliver Baumann made a superb athletic save to deny him. Bayern Munich win a corner.
6' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) was quite harsh and Tobias Stieler didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

4' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) is lurking on the edge of the box and receives a pass from Michael Olise. He shows nice control before hitting a soft shot just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Hoffenheim will have the kick-off.
Tobias Stieler was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
